identification: Large two-part canted-front (three-facet bow) display cabinet / china hutch, honey-toned timber catalogued as blackwood, upper with four arched-top glazed doors, mirror back and three glass shelves; base with four arched fielded-panel doors, two centre drawers and open centre cupboard, plinth base, brass drop handles. Late 20th century Tasmanian cabinetmaker or factory reproduction-style dining furniture (1980s-2000s). H194 W154 D40 cm.
